title: La La Land
description: A mod pack made for The faceland minecraft server.
body:
rA modpack for The faceland minecraft server, Made by me(The modpack, not the server).
It Contains many mods i like:

- Q.O.L Mods
- Performance Mods
- Decorative Mods/Resource packs
- Fancymenu customizations
- And etc...

Quick FAQ:

Q1: "Why make the modpack?"

A1: Tbh, because i wanted to make a modpack to this new experience of mine
(And hopefully yours too)

Q2: "Why the name?"

A2: Because it Sounded funnier in my head, and because it's a refrence to a movie(which i only heard the name of).

Q3: "What is Faceland?"

A3: A Very Cool Minecraft Server, which i think should get more eyes on it!
Please Check The [FaceLand Website](https://face.land/)!

Q4: "Why is it in beta?"

A4: I forgor💀

That's all, For now!

Requirments:

- A Computer(or a phone with Pojav/zalith/2)
- 4gb of Ram Allocated to it
- A decent gpu/cpu
- The Correct Renderer(For Pojav/Zalith/2)

To-Do list:

- Add More Pojav/Zalith/2 Support □
- Add more decorative features to the modpack □
- Meow □w□
